name: Kingrinder K4
details: Hand grinder with external adjustment: 60 clicks per rotation, counted anti-clockwise from zero. KINGrinder: don't grind at zero or below 15 clicks.

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (adjustment nut turned clockwise until it stops)

notes.moka: KINGrinder groups moka pot and AeroPress (60–90).
notes.aeropress: KINGrinder groups moka pot and AeroPress (60–90).

rangeInfo.note: KINGrinder K4/K6 manual (hosted on Amazon), “Recommended grinder settings”, K4 column: Turkish coffee 15–50 clicks, espresso 50–60, moka pot/AeroPress 60–90, pour-over 80–100, French press 140. “One circle is equivalent to 60 clicks.” Kingrinder's site chart gives the K4 slightly coarser medium (90–120) and coarse (150) settings.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: French press: 130–150 around the manual's single setting of 140; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range; drip coffee maker: the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser. Dial in from there.
